name: PricingTable
description: Fila de PricingCard sobre una malla de color desenfocada (Backdrop mesh con semilla); se reparte por el ancho y se apila en estrecho.

props.name: label
props.description: Nombre de la región para lectores.

props.name: seed
props.description: Semilla de la malla del fondo.

a11y: section con nombre. La malla es aria-hidden.

examples.title: Tres planes
examples.code:
<PricingTable label="Plans" seed={11}>
  <PricingCard tone="success" name="Basic" price={{ amount: 29, currency: "USD", locale: "en-US", period: "/ month" }} features={[{ label: "3 projects" }, { label: "Custom brands", included: false }]} action={<Button>Choose Basic</Button>} />
  <PricingCard featured badge="Most popular" tone="info" name="Professional" price={{ amount: 39, currency: "USD", locale: "en-US", period: "/ month" }} features={[{ label: "Unlimited projects" }, { label: "Custom brands" }]} action={<Button variant="primary">Choose Professional</Button>} />
</PricingTable>
